- **Predicted properties:** ~50.8 kDa; theoretical pI 8.63; GRAVY −0.565, indicating an overall hydrophilic sequence.
- **Domain:** Pfam movement-protein domain **MP (PF01107)**, residues 12–201.
- **Associated annotations:** serine-type endopeptidase activity, proteolysis, suppression of host innate immune response, and virus cell-to-cell transport.
